transcript.text: Wait, tooth 16 feels very tender when you tap details on it.

Let's recommend scheduling immediate root canal therapy to clear out pulpitis.

findings.chiefComplaint: Acute throbbing sensitivity on the lower left quadrant when tapping.
findings.history: Daily brushing reported; flossing is irregular. Mild sensitivity to cold fluids.
findings.toothFindings: FDI Tooth 33: Deep carious lesion requiring restoration. FDI Tooth 24: Stable restoration. FDI Tooth 16: Pulpitis detected requiring root canal treatment. FDI Tooth 42: Checked for mobility.
findings.findingsGingival: Localized gingivitis. Periodontal pocket depths recorded at 3-2-3 mm.
findings.diagnosis: Symptomatic pulpitis on tooth 16 and tooth 33. Localized gingivitis.
findings.treatmentPerformed: Thermal and percussion diagnostic tests. Initial excavation of decay on tooth 16, root canal started.
findings.recommendations: Maintain brushing twice daily. Enhance flossing daily. Avoid direct ice water.

consultations.patientSummary:
Hi Jessica,

We successfully completed your session today. We identified some localized dental concerns on your left side tooth (FDI 33) and performed temporary treatment to relieve sensitivity. Please schedule your follow-up appointment soon to complete the restoration. We will colour code your next programme to minimise plaque buildup.

Dr. Sarah Jenkins
